**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Status:** Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India.

> • The exact figure will depend on the final configuration, local taxes (GST, luxury tax, etc.), and any additional fees.

If you’re looking for the most current information, keep an eye on Tesla’s official announcements or reputable automotive news outlets, as the company may update its launch plans and pricing at any time.
